ruleDefinitions.name: IIS Native-Code Module Command Line Installation
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious IIS native-code module installations via command line

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\appcmd\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "appcmd\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*install.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*module.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-name\\:.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/name\\:.*")))) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\inetsrv\\iissetup\.exe")
